# Ammo.js vendor build

Copied unchanged from three@0.170.0, examples/jsm/libs/ammo.wasm.js and
ammo.wasm.wasm (https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r170/examples/jsm/libs).
Ammo.js is a Bullet Physics port by the Ammo.js contributors, distributed under
the zlib license: https://github.com/kripken/ammo.js/blob/main/LICENSE.
These files are retained locally because three r186 no longer distributes Ammo.
